title: Robot won't connect in the pit
summary: Driver Station cannot reach the robot off the field, on a tether or the team's own radio. No FMS involved.

start.question: How is the laptop connected to the robot?
start.help: Off the field there is no FMS. The Driver Station talks to the roboRIO directly.

options.label: USB cable straight to the roboRIO
Connected, but the DS says No Robot Code

usb-tether.title: USB tether to the roboRIO
steps: Use a known good USB A to B cable from the laptop to the roboRIO USB device port, the square one.
Confirm the roboRIO is booted. The Status light goes off when boot completes.
The roboRIO comes up as a network adapter at 172.22.11.2. In ncpa.cpl confirm that adapter is enabled and set to automatic (DHCP).
Turn the laptop Wi-Fi off and disable other adapters so the Driver Station does not take a different route.

steps.text: Does the DS connect over USB?

steps: Try another USB cable and another port. A charge-only cable carries power but no data.
Turn off the Windows firewall on all three profiles, then restart the Driver Station software.

steps.text: Is there still nothing over USB?
steps.yes: Work the roboRIO guide. The RIO may not be booting.
